title: Rent Roll

origin.publisher: Neil Walter Company Commercial Real Estate
origin.title: Lund Pointe Apartments Offering Memorandum (Rent Roll, page 11)
origin.clearance_note: Page 11 of a 17-page offering memorandum that the listing broker publishes on its own website to market the property to buyers; downloaded by script. Only the rent roll page is used. It carries no tenant names, lease dates, deposits or other personal data: just unit numbers, layouts, status, square footage and rents. The source PDF's document metadata, which named the preparer's user account, was cleared when the page was split out.

notes: Features the rent roll's totals row, so the overlay reads as one summary of the property: 25 units, 100% occupied, 23,760 square feet, $22,280 a month. The request file named no fields; its research notes suggested these four plus unit A-101's rent ($1,215). A-101's rent was dropped because inspect_fields marks every per-unit dollar and square-foot value OFF: extraction returns them as floats (1215.0) and the matcher does not equate that with '$1,215', although the boxed cell is the right one. Only rows marked ok are featured. The 'Other Charges' column repeats the Total column on every row, an error in the source; the schema extracts it as printed, and it is not featured.
